children: Crane reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $754.6 million, up 28.1% year over year, and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.05, a record. GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations was $1.66, while net income from continuing operations was $97.3 million. The company raised its full-year adjusted EPS outlook to $7.23–$7.38.
Net sales were $754.6 million, an increase of 28.1% year over year. Adjusted net sales, excluding tariff refunds paid to customers, were $756.7 million, up 28.4%.
Operating profit was $140.6 million, up 18.8%; operating margin was 18.6%, down 150 basis points. Adjusted operating profit was $169.9 million, up 35.8%, with a 22.5% adjusted margin.
Net income from continuing operations attributable to common shareholders was $97.3 million, compared with $91.4 million a year earlier.
Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $1.66, versus $1.56. Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.05, up 23% from $1.67.
Crane raised and narrowed its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $7.23–$7.38, from $6.85–$7.05.
Aerospace & Advanced Technologies delivered 9.5% core sales growth; Process Flow Technologies recorded 6.2% core sales growth and 19.7% core order growth.
Total company core backlog grew 9% year over year. Backlog increased 9% in Aerospace & Advanced Technologies and 8% in Process Flow Technologies.
Crane said acquisitions completed earlier in the year were performing ahead of expectations. Acquisition contributions supported results across both segments.

The company agreed to sell its UK-based Crane Building Services & Utilities business for £230 million and separately announced an agreement to acquire Trillium Flow Technologies’ U.S. water and wastewater pump business. The transactions are subject to customary approvals; the acquisition is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 and the divestiture in early 2027.

Crane said the portfolio moves are intended to focus Process Flow Technologies on engineered, mission-critical products and technologies serving markets including pharmaceuticals, water and wastewater, power, cryogenics and nuclear.

title: Crane Raises 2026 Adjusted EPS Outlook After Record Third-Quarter Result
